entities.summary: Jacob Greer Cohen is an American-Israeli 6' 10 3⁄4" tall former professional basketball player. He played nine seasons for Maccabi Tel Aviv of the Israeli Basketball Premier League and the EuroLeague. He has also represented the Israeli national team in international competitions.
